row.team_price_text: Standard: $34.90/mo per concurrent-user licence, billed at $418.80/year
row.evidence: ISL Online's SSO guide requires an ISL Online Premium Cloud License and says the SAML 2.0 identity provider handles "provisioning and managing"; new users are created on first SSO sign-on, and no SCIM endpoint is documented on the pricing page, help centre or API docs.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM at any tier. Prices are per concurrent-user licence (Standard $34.90/mo billed at $418.80/year covers 40 licensed users and 1 concurrent session; Premium $54.90/mo billed at $658.80/year adds SSO/SAML). Starter ($16.90/mo) is a single licensed user, so Standard is the team plan. SAML SSO (Premium, Self-Hosted, Enterprise MPC) creates users JIT on first sign-on and then disables user creation in the web portal. Okta, Entra and Google are set up as custom SAML apps; none is in an IdP catalogue. The pricing table lists a REST API from Standard up, but the public API docs (Hosted Service Integrator API) only document session integration and integrator/user/login/1, with no user-management endpoints. Self-hosted servers can use LDAP/AD external authentication.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere. The SSO guide puts provisioning on the customer's IdP and relies on JIT creation at first SAML sign-on; help-centre searches for 'scim' and 'provisioning' return no articles.

limitations.text: The public API docs cover the Hosted Service Integrator API (session integration, jQuery plugin, JWT requests); the only user method named is integrator/user/login/1. No user create/update/delete endpoints are documented.

user_api.notes: The pricing comparison lists a 'REST API' row as N/A on Starter and included from Standard up, but what it covers is not documented publicly.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'isl online' returns no results; ISL's own guide builds a custom SAML 2.0 app via Create App Integration.

entra.notes: ISL's Entra guide uses 'Create your own application' (Non-gallery) for SAML.

google.notes: ISL's Google Workspace guide uses 'Add custom SAML app'.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP/Active Directory external authentication on self-hosted ISL Conference Proxy servers
fallbacks.notes: CSV is export-only (users can be exported to CSV/JSON); no CSV import is documented.
